verdict.rationale: Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin auto-creates/opens a note for today's date (obsidian-docs-4), and the separate Templates core plugin can insert pre-defined snippets (obsidian-docs-5), and community users confirm using Obsidian for daily journaling/dev notes (obsidian-comm-2, obsidian-comm-17). However, the evidence never explicitly documents the Daily Notes + Template integration (i.e., specifying a template file that auto-populates the daily note) nor confirms it as the app's default landing view on launch — missing for 10: explicit doc on linking a template to Daily Notes settings, and evidence of daily note being the default startup/landing page.
